assessments.reasoning: The Tour README introduces an interactive resource about the Gleam programming language. The separate Build section describes a JavaScript host and a downloaded compiler for constructing the site.

challenge.method: Read the README introduction and build sections alongside the separate project compiler README. Test whether the interactive site, JavaScript build host or editor grammar supplies the language referent.
challenge.results: The named language is the subject of the Tour. Its host and compiler are distinct implementation artifacts used by the resource.

limitations: This does not establish runtime properties or target or compiler edition applicability for an arbitrary Gleam program.
